title: LibraryAppliedData
description: Data of the library.applied event of earlier versions of Gentry, which applied the shared subagents, then called the library of subagents, by a command of their own: their draft became active on this machine. The event has no project. Gentry no longer writes it: the shared subagents are applied with the flow of a project, by flow.applied; the journal keeps the events written before.

commit.description: Hash of the commit of the process repository that applied the shared subagents.
